involved_tools.description:
Converts a date and time from a source timezone to a target timezone.

Usage rules:
- Provide all three required fields: time, sourceTimezone, and targetTimezone.
- Provide time in 24-hour format, for example 2025-03-23 12:30:00.
- Use IANA timezone names for sourceTimezone and targetTimezone, such as Asia/Shanghai and Europe/London.

sourceTimezone.description: The source timezone. IANA timezone name, e.g. Asia/Shanghai

targetTimezone.description: The target timezone. IANA timezone name, e.g. Europe/London

time.description: Date and time in 24-hour format. e.g. 2025-03-23 12:30:00

involved_tools.name: current_time
involved_tools.description:
Returns the current date and time, optionally formatted for a specified timezone.

Usage rules:
- Optionally provide timezone as an IANA timezone name, such as Asia/Shanghai.
- Optionally select format from the supported values: h:mm A, h:mm:ss A, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, MM/DD/YYYY, MM/DD/YY, YYYY/MM/DD, or YYYY/MM.
- If format is omitted, it defaults to YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.

timezone.description: The timezone of the time, IANA timezone name, e.g. Asia/Shanghai
